controls.title: Insufficient Credential Hygiene
controls.text: Credentials used by pipelines and infrastructure code should be short-lived and scoped to least privilege, and never hardcoded in source; rotate and revoke them promptly if exposed.

controls.title: Improper Artifact Integrity Validation
controls.text: Pipelines and IaC definitions that pull external modules, images, or packages should pin to an exact, verified version and validate integrity before use, rather than trusting a mutable reference.
